required_bindings.adp_anisotropic_selection: Exact atom-selection string for refinement.refine.adp.individual.anisotropic (macromolecular heavy atoms; never inferred from tier name alone).
required_bindings.adp_isotropic_selection: Exact atom-selection string for refinement.refine.adp.individual.isotropic (waters isotropic in [0.90, 1.50) A; below 0.90 A governed by Stage 2 dev test).
required_bindings.sub_0p90_water_adp_mode: Stage 2 development-set choice ('isotropic' or 'anisotropic') for water ADPs at d_min < 0.90 A (U04).

unresolved_notes: At d_min < 0.90 A, water ADP policy (isotropic vs. anisotropic) is explicitly unresolved until frozen on the 23-structure Stage 2 development set (U04), and requires an explicit source-bound water-selection audit declaration (#1337).
